sub_graphs.description: Models how account state is represented and transitions through the Account dataclass structure

nodes.label: Empty Account State
nodes.description: Account exists with default values: nonce=0, balance=0, code=empty bytes

nodes.label: Initialized Account State
nodes.description: Account with non-default values for nonce, balance, or code

nodes.label: Create Account
nodes.description: Initialize a new Account dataclass with specified nonce, balance, and code

nodes.label: Encode Account for Storage
nodes.description: RLP-encode account combining nonce, balance, storage_root, and keccak256(code)

nodes.label: Account Encoded for Trie
nodes.description: Account data encoded as RLP bytes ready for trie insertion

sub_graphs.title: Prague Fork Types: Authorization Validation
sub_graphs.description: Models the Authorization structure for EIP-7702 set code transactions and its validation

nodes.label: Authorization Received
nodes.description: Raw authorization tuple received with chain_id, address, nonce, y_parity, r, s

nodes.label: Validate Authorization Chain ID
nodes.description: Verify chain_id matches current chain or is zero (wildcard)

nodes.label: Validate Authorization Signature
nodes.description: Verify y_parity, r, s form a valid ECDSA signature

nodes.label: Recover Authority Address
nodes.description: Recover the signing address from the authorization signature

nodes.label: Authorization Valid
nodes.description: Authorization validated and authority address recovered

nodes.label: Authorization Invalid
nodes.description: Authorization failed validation (wrong chain, invalid signature)

sub_graphs.description: Models the type constraints that enforce data integrity at system boundaries

nodes.label: Raw Bytes Received
nodes.description: Untyped byte data received at system boundary

nodes.label: Validate as Address (Bytes20)
nodes.description: Verify bytes are exactly 20 bytes for Address type

nodes.label: Validate as Root (Hash32)
nodes.description: Verify bytes are exactly 32 bytes for Root type

nodes.label: Validate as Bloom (Bytes256)
nodes.description: Verify bytes are exactly 256 bytes for Bloom filter

nodes.label: Valid Root Type
nodes.description: Data validated as proper 32-byte Root hash

nodes.label: Valid Bloom Type
nodes.description: Data validated as proper 256-byte Bloom filter

external_entities.name: External Data Source
external_entities.description: Any external source providing byte data (RPC, P2P, storage)

ambiguities.text: The Account dataclass stores 'code' but the specification does not clarify whether the code field must be validated (e.g., for EOF format in Prague)
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume code field stores raw bytecode without format validation at the Account level; validation happens at execution time

ambiguities.text: Authorization nonce field uses U64 type while Account nonce uses Uint - unclear if these are semantically equivalent
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume U64 is used for authorization nonce to match EIP-7702 specification requirements; they are compared as unsigned integers

implicit_assumptions.description: The storage_root parameter passed to encode_account is assumed to be a valid Merkle Patricia Trie root computed correctly
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Invalid storage roots could corrupt state integrity, allowing state manipulation attacks

implicit_assumptions.description: Assumes attacker cannot forge ECDSA signatures for Authorization structures without knowing the private key
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Attackers could create unauthorized set-code authorizations, hijacking accounts

implicit_assumptions.description: EMPTY_ACCOUNT constant is used as the canonical representation of non-existent accounts
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Inconsistent empty account handling could lead to state confusion between empty and non-existent accounts
